fallbacks.title: Platform defaults for uncovered controls
fallbacks.statement: If the system defines no control for a need, theme the platform's native element with the system's own control language (soft border, radius 4, blue glow focus); keep native semantics.
constraints: styled in the system's own control language (soft border, radius 4)
mark the improvisation and report a gap if the need recurs

source.repo: FIP design standard + canada.ca live web layer

exception.reason: Authored policy for needs the system does not cover: platform controls themed from the system's own control language, marked and reported as a gap. No source decision states this policy. Revised 2026-10-11 per owner ruling (original wording rejected).
exception.basis: Synthesis protocol phase 5; styling follows D-11 (fields) and D-12 (small-set select).

fallbacks.title: Selection beyond small sets
fallbacks.statement: Small fixed sets use the select; larger or filtered selection uses the platform default, marked.
